item.title: Create tutorial
item.description:
Introduction

First of all, thanks to consider making a new tutorial! By providing a tutorial, you are actively supporting your colleagues and the wider community and making work more efficient.

In this page, the roadmap towards a new tutorial will be explained.

Writing a tutorial

Each tutorial is setup in a subfolder of the content/tutorials folder. Within this folder, different files and formats may exist as you create them, but a file with the name index.md will be used for the tutorials website. So, you can create the tutorial directly in markdown or create it based on a Rmarkdown, a Jupyter notebook, quarto or any other format, as long as there is a single markdown file with the name index.md in your tutorial folder.
